representative_test: Gauge-boson, charged-lepton, quark and Higgs spectrum; three active light neutrino species
result: All established collider states fit the SU(3)_C x SU(2)_L x U(1)_Y representation pattern; no confirmed extra elementary state
caveat: This verifies a low-energy representation pattern, not uniqueness or completeness

result: ATLAS combined mass m_H = 125.11 +/- 0.11 GeV; measured couplings are SM-like within present precision
caveat: Self-coupling and total width remain much less precise than the mass

representative_test: W and Z observables, neutral currents, loop-sensitive global fits
result: ATLAS m_W = 80366.5 +/- 15.9 MeV is compatible with electroweak fits
caveat: CDF II reports a significantly higher value; this is an inter-experiment tension, not a settled SM failure

representative_test: Running coupling, jets, heavy flavours, hadron spectrum and lattice observables
result: Asymptotic freedom and perturbative factorization succeed at high scales; nonperturbative QCD reproduces extensive hadron and thermodynamic data
caveat: Confinement is not derived by a complete analytic theorem in four-dimensional continuum Yang-Mills

representative_test: CKM structure, neutral-meson mixing, rare decays and quark-sector CP violation
result: A single CKM phase organizes a large body of flavour data
caveat: First-row CKM, selected semileptonic observables and hadronic inputs remain precision watchpoints; flavour parameters are fitted, not explained

representative_test: Oscillation phases and direct beta-endpoint mass
result: Oscillations establish nonzero mass splittings and mixing; KATRIN gives m_beta < 0.45 eV (90% CL)
caveat: The renormalizable SM without right-handed neutrinos predicts massless neutrinos; the mass origin and Dirac/Majorana character remain open

representative_test: Differential free fall of Ti and Pt
caveat: The bound is composition- and range-dependent for particular new fields

representative_test: Post-Keplerian timing and orbital damping in the double pulsar
result: Multiple strong-field effects agree with GR; quadrupolar radiation damping is tested at roughly 1.3 x 10^-4
caveat: This does not probe Planck curvature or all strong-field alternatives

representative_test: Generation, propagation, polarization and merger/ringdown consistency
result: GWTC-4.0 parameterized tests find no evidence beyond GR; m_g <= 1.92 x 10^-23 eV/c^2 at 90% credibility
caveat: Waveform systematics and model flexibility remain part of every precision test

representative_test: Horizon-scale imaging and compact-object surface constraints
result: EHT and GW observations are consistent with compact objects described by GR black-hole exteriors
caveat: Observations do not prove the classical interior or singularity structure

representative_test: CMB TT/TE/EE+lensing under flat six-parameter LambdaCDM
result: Planck finds H0 = 67.4 +/- 0.5 km/s/Mpc, Omega_m = 0.315 +/- 0.007 and n_s = 0.965 +/- 0.004 in base LambdaCDM
caveat: The fit depends on the model, initial perturbation ansatz and recombination/foreground systematics

representative_test: BAO, supernova distances and local distance ladder
result: DESI DR2 BAO is well described by flat LambdaCDM but combined datasets give model- and supernova-sample-dependent preference for evolving dark energy
caveat: A preference under an extended parametrization is not an established new component

representative_test: Nearly scale-invariant adiabatic scalar spectrum and tensor searches
result: CMB data support a near-power-law scalar spectrum; BK18 gives r_0.05 < 0.036 (95% CL)
caveat: No unique inflationary field content or alternative mechanism has been selected

representative_test: CMB/structure/lensing abundance plus direct nuclear recoil searches
regime: galactic to cosmological; keV to TeV candidates
result: A non-baryonic gravitating component is required in the standard cosmological fit; LZ finds no WIMP excess in 4.2 tonne-years
caveat: Null WIMP searches exclude models, not the astrophysical evidence for missing gravitating matter
